body.message:
That works out to about 5 months from April 10. The rate is AED 7,900/month, all-inclusive.

Our rates are locked in 3-month blocks, so we can confirm April 10 to July 10 at that rate now. For July to September, it's summer pricing, which tends to be the same or lower, and we'd confirm that with you ahead of time.

Want to get the paperwork started?
